definitions: To emphasize that one personally witnessed something, leaving no doubt about its authenticity or occurrence.
To state with certainty that an event or situation was directly observed by the speaker.
examples: I know you find it hard to believe, but I saw it with my own two eyes.
He claimed the dog could talk, and I saw it with my own two eyes!
Don't tell me it didn't happen; I saw it with my own two eyes.
lemma: to see it with one's own two eyes
source: i saw it with my own two eyes
